title: Provisioning job (tenant job)
caption: platform.provisioning_jobs.status; kinds provision, migrate, suspend, resume (export, delete, restore, rotate_secrets reserved). One queued or running job per tenant and kind (provisioning_jobs_active_uq). The job page offers Retry only on failed and Cancel job only on queued.

states.label: queued
states.detail: Waiting for dispatch or its next attempt (`scheduled_at`). **Cancel job** (reason).

states.label: running
states.detail: BullMQ job `<jobId>-<attempt>` on `ota-tenant-ops`; lease `locked_until`. No action.

states.label: failed
states.detail: Attempts used up or not retryable. **Retry** creates a new job; this one stays as history.

transitions.label: Retry → new job of the same kind
